verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no provider-published tokens-per-second figures, latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides. Groq's docs only make general claims such as "Fast LLM inference" and offer latency-tunable service tiers, which is a related feature rather than published performance data. The community-reported throughput figures (~450–491 T/s) are independent user measurements, not provider publications, and Groq staff comments in the AMA describe the architecture qualitatively without numbers.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
